feedback: Decision: approve. This candidate is valid and changes only two fields from the best raced design (iteration 4, score 56.11): base_speed 1.4 to 1.2 and line_loss search_right to search_left. Geometry, kp, ki, kd and sensor weights are unchanged. The evidence supports both changes as tests. (1) Oval max_error was 0.0605 in iteration 4, just over the 0.06 m off-track limit, with 0 line-loss events and progress 0.137. Speed was 1.4 in iterations 3 and 4, and oval max_error has stayed at 0.0605 to 0.0614 across iterations 0 to 4, so slower entry into the first corner is the untested lever. (2) On s-bend and slalom, line_loss_events stayed at 1 with search_right (iteration 4) and with last_direction (iterations 0 to 3), and progress barely moved (s-bend 0.1576, slalom 0.1099). The recovery direction is therefore the untested variable for those tracks. The risk is that two fields change at once. Speed mainly affects the oval and recovery direction mainly affects s-bend and slalom, so the per-track telemetry should separate them. Read the race as follows. (a) If oval progress falls below 0.137 at speed 1.2, the speed is too low; return base_speed to 1.4 and keep search_left. (b) If s-bend or slalom line_loss_events drops to 0, or their progress rises above 0.1576 and 0.1099, keep search_left. (c) If s-bend or slalom line_loss_events rise above 1, the search direction is wrong; revise to search_right with the same geometry. (d) If steering_oscillation rises well above 0.15, reduce kd toward 0.20 before changing kp. Do not treat this candidate as better than iteration 4 until the race shows it.
requested_changes: If oval progress falls below 0.137 at base_speed 1.2 (iteration 4 value at 1.4), set base_speed back to 1.4 and keep line_loss search_left, so the search-direction result is still tested.

If s-bend or slalom line_loss_events stays at 1 with search_left, set line_loss back to search_right and test base_speed 1.2 alone, since search_right gave one loss per run on those tracks in iteration 4 and no change in progress.
If oval max_error stays at or above 0.06 at base_speed 1.2 with 0 line losses, try sensor_size 0.016 with the same speed and keep the change to one group at a time before changing kp.
